description: Returns the actual pixels of one frame, already downscaled to a size the model can read. Useful for visual questions that the text and coordinates cannot settle, such as spacing, visual style, colour balance, or imagery with no text in it. Costs substantially more tokens than the structured form of the same capture.

frame.description: 1-based frame number. Scroll captures have several, top to bottom.

id.description: Capture id. Omit to use the newest capture.

name: get_capture_image
title: Get one frame of a capture as an image
